prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions are mostly too high, though they were too low for the finish redesign in round 6 (+1.5% predicted vs +3.1% noise-corrected).
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) is helpful, averaging +2.2% after noise correction across 2 tests with 1 winning test, though 1 test showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for adding new adoption screens (adoption, new_screen) as there is only 1 test, which showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for finish redesigns (finish, redesign) with only 1 test, despite it winning.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +3.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 71.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight friend picker with animated preview: Redesign the companion selection screen into a spotlight layout showcasing animated pet previews with direct selection cards. (why: Adoption has a steep drop-off (60.9% conversion, median 89s), indicating users take a long time evaluating options.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after completion waiting: Reorder sign-in to occur after pet asset creation completes in waiting, right before home introduction. (why: Earlier sign-in reordering proved effective (+2.2% conversion), and moving sign-in after generation ensures pet creation is already finished.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop visibility verification flow: Add a two-column desktop visibility verification guide on home_intro with a checklist to ensure the pet renders properly. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not appearing on the desktop, and finish step mean time is 5815s with 29% drop-off.)
3: [home, wait_info] Live status and progress tip carousel: Add a progress bar and rotating tip carousel on the waiting screen to keep users entertained while pet assets generate. (why: Waiting step drop-off is 18.7% and mean duration is 2336s, indicating users disengage during generation.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Story scroll layout for path choice: Change choose_path layout to story_scroll to combine narrative background with immediate path selection. (why: choose_path has a 23.8% drop-off and high mean time (514s), showing users spend too long deciding without narrative flow.)
5: [adoption, copy] Photo quality guidance for custom pets: Update photo upload headline, body, and hint text to specify bright lighting and single-pet focus. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, contributing to adoption drop-off.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop alert when pet generation completes: Enable desktop completion notification toggle on the waiting screen so users are notified when pet creation finishes. (why: Mean wait time is 2336s; notifying users outside the window allows them to multitask without abandoning setup.)

scores.note: Adoption step has the highest drop-off (39.1%), but creating animated previews requires new UI development.
Sign-in reordering has proven historical success (+2.2% average relative lift).
Supported strongly by both funnel drop-off (29%) and 3 support emails, but requires new verification screens.
Addresses high wait duration on home screen (2336s) by entertaining users during asset generation.
Targets 23.8% drop-off at step 1, but narrative layout redesign requires new component work.
Low cost copy tweak backed by both adoption drop-off and 3 support emails regarding failed pet uploads.
Allows multitasking during long generation time (2336s mean duration) via desktop alerts.
